svg.title: Night Patience: Art deco playing cards
svg.desc: Night Patience (1D): solitaire on green baize under the office lamp. Six columns sit under brass room numbers 401 to 406; a red-on-black run is being carried onto a black seven, a dotted arc showing where it lands. On the spike at the right, one card from another deck has slipped out of the stock, its face handwritten.
